title: Collections, iterators, and generators — concept map
intro: Arrays and typed arrays, Map/Set/Weak collections, iterator protocol, generators, performance tradeoffs, immutability patterns, and mapping to C# List/Dictionary/LINQ.

overviewDiagram.title: Collections learning path
overviewDiagram.source:
flowchart LR
  A[Array and typed arrays] --> B[Map Set WeakMap]
  B --> C[Iterators for-of]
  C --> D[Generators yield]
  D --> E[Performance choices]
  E --> F[Immutability]
  F --> G[vs C# collections]

conceptCards.title: Array and typed arrays
conceptCards.summary: Dynamic Array vs ArrayBuffer views. Sparse holes vs undefined. Array-like needs Array.from.

conceptCards.title: Map and Set
conceptCards.summary: Any key type; SameValueZero; insertion order. WeakMap for GC-friendly metadata.

conceptCards.title: Iterator protocol
conceptCards.summary: next() value/done. Symbol.iterator makes iterable. for...of not for...in on arrays.

conceptCards.title: Generators
conceptCards.summary: function* pauses at yield. Lazy pagination. Do not spread infinite sequences.

conceptCards.title: Performance
conceptCards.summary: Set.has vs Array.includes. Map for dynamic keys. Object for JSON DTO.

conceptCards.title: Immutability
conceptCards.summary: Spread shallow. structuredClone deep. React needs new reference.

conceptCards.title: vs C#
conceptCards.summary: List→Array, Dictionary→Map, foreach→for...of. filter/map eager vs LINQ defer.
